title: Excavations in Palestine, 1934-5: Tell en Nasbe
author: (round-up; expedition directed by W. F. Badé)
screen_term: Tell en Nasbe (Tell en-Nasbeh; not in the gazetteer)
location_note: Tell en-Nasbeh; no map reference. INFERENCE: placed in Z4 by its known position (about 31.885 N, 35.217 E); no distance computed.
notes: Fifth season: whole mound and city wall (c. 900 BC, attributed to Asa), suburbs, houses, Mizpah (MZPH) seal impressions. Seventeen tombs, of which two Early Bronze and one Early Iron are dated in the text; the rest are not described. Same site as QDAP2-192; not deduplicated.
